variants.name: 500 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Highly varied snack mix with grains, fruit and vegetables
  • A delicious natural mixture based on puffed cereals, fruit and vegetable flakes
  • Prevents boredom and brings variation to the daily menu
  • Ideal snack for hamsters, dwarf hamsters, rats, gerbils and mice
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: grains (puffed wheat 16%, puffed maize 16%, puffed rice 4%), fruit (banana 4%, raisins 3%), derivatives of vegetable origin, vegetables (peas 8%), vegetable protein extracts, minerals, seeds, herbs, MOS, FOS, algae, yucca.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 10.5%, crude fat 3%, crude fibre 4%, crude ash 3.4%, calcium 0.4%, phosphorus 0.4%.
variants.feeding_instructions: A complementary treat alongside the daily Nature basic feed. Use in moderation. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature feed and Timothy Hay.
